name: validator-gap-events-non-object-item-also-reports-type
description: An applied event that is not an object: only `must be an object`, or also `type must be a string`?
gap: The type rule says `for every event that is applied`; the contract does not say whether an item that is not an object is an event for this rule. Both readings are plausible.
alternatives: vec.json: events[0] must be an object
vec.json: events[0] must be an object
vec.json: events[0].type must be a string
